scheme_name: Scheme for Promoting Young Talents in Science-I (SPYTiS-I)
other_conditions: Students must be enrolled in schools in Kerala and studying in classes VIII to XII.
Groups can contain a maximum of 5 students.
Each school may submit up to 10 proposals, and each teacher supervisor may submit up to 2 proposals.
Applications must be signed and forwarded by the Head of the Institution.
Proposals must follow the prescribed format and be submitted by the stated deadline.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹5,000 per group of up to 5 students for a one‑year science project.
